functional_attachment_validation_gates: Every independently moving item has a stable attachment ID, owner character, authored anchor/socket, pivot, transform space, and draw order; do not merge items that must move independently.
Weapons follow authored hand/back grips, stow transitions, facing changes, and attack events; firing/recoil/swing cues must be driven by the combat event stream, not by animation timers.

Drone and decoy transforms have explicit owners and independent IDs. SPARK has three attack drones; ECHO exact count and drone/decoy mapping remain unresolved. No presentation script schedules damage, chooses targets, or invents formation/flight cadence.

Accessories, armor, cloth, cables, tools, and medical/chem equipment have explicit ownership and pass idle, walk, attack, hit, defeat, and applicable facing/ability poses for clipping, joint connection, readability, and secondary motion.

Only ability cues named in the roster are linked to ability events; the simulation remains authoritative for target selection, damage, movement, ability activation, and outcome. Animation, weapon effects, and drones visualize simulation events.
Record source-backed attachment counts and pivots; flag unspecified behavior and any contradiction rather than inferring gameplay from concept art.
